parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: The switch is the handle of the faucet, typically made of stainless steel, used to control water flow and temperature.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to turn the water on or off and adjust the temperature by rotating or lifting the handle.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate or tilt around a pivot axis to regulate water flow and temperature.

parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: The frame is the main body of the faucet, made of brass for durability and corrosion resistance.
parts.Functional_description: It houses the internal water channels and connects the faucet to the plumbing system.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and provides structural support for the switch and spout.

parts.name: Spout
parts.Basic_description: The spout is the outlet part of the faucet, made of stainless steel, through which water flows out.
parts.Functional_description: It directs the water stream from the faucet to the sink or basin.
parts.Movement_description: It is typically fixed but may swivel in some designs to adjust the direction of water flow.
